title: llm.output payload
description: One call of the LLM gateway, recorded before the answer is used (data-model.md 7.2, contracts.md C-07 v1.3). The record key for a replay is (meta.correlation_id, meta.agent.id, phase, attempt), so correlation_id, agent, actor_kind, replay and gm_path live in meta and are not repeated here (ADR-007 p. 1). validation_status is the outcome of the pipeline; the reasons of a refusal belong to llm.output.rejected alone (ADR-017 addendum 1).

provider.description: The name from MV_LLM_PROVIDER, never an address. The pattern is the whole point: the field said 'a name and nothing else' in prose while accepting a URL, and this event lives in llm_records for the whole retention of the topic (T-215).

params.description: Sampling of the request (contracts.md C-15 v1.1). Recorded as sent, so that a replay reproduces the call.

prompt_hash.description: The prompt itself is kept in local storage behind a flag; the record carries the hash only (SEC-23). Form sha256:<64 lowercase hex> (C-07 v1.3), the form shared/entity.StateHash already writes.

response_hash.description: Form sha256:<64 lowercase hex> (C-07 v1.3). Carried when the text itself is withheld, so an audit can still tell two answers apart.

reasons.description: Denormalised set of the reasons of the related llm.output.rejected, so that a report needs no join (C-07 v1.2).

parse.description: How the parser recovered the JSON of the answer (ADR-016 p. 1, C-07 v1.1).

reasoning_len.description: Length of the reasoning_content the gateway threw away (Response.ReasoningLen, C-15 v1.1). The length and nothing else: the reasoning text itself is never recorded (ADR-005 add. 2 p. 1).

error.description: Present when and only when validation_status=error. code=yielded means a background call gave the queue up to a player turn (ADR-014 p. 2).

$comment: What a field depends on is split in two (C-07 v1.3). A condition on validation_status alone is here, one if/then per row of the table of C-07. A condition on the stage the pipeline reached — filter at invalid, reasons[] against the related llm.output.rejected — is not a property of one record and is held by the property tests of the gateway (T-211, T-213).

allOf.$comment: A text that was parsed is kept: the answer was used, partly used or judged unusable, and a replay needs the text in every one of those cases.
An answer that was used went through the category (a) filter and passed it (ADR-016 p. 3).
A text the filter blocked is left unstored: the record keeps the hash and the length, and content.incident.recorded carries the fact without the text (C-07, orchestrator decision on OV-33).
The filter itself failed, so the text was never judged: it is withheld on the same grounds as a blocked one (fail-closed, orchestrator decision on OV-33).
There is no answer: the provider failed, timed out or the call yielded. What went wrong is error{code}; there is no text and nothing was filtered.
error{} belongs to validation_status=error alone: a record with an answer and an error at once would leave a report guessing which one is true.
